_comment: Hand-maintained cup/European fixture occurrence, merged OVER anything
scrapers/fixture_occurrence.py scrapes. This is a first-class input, not
a fallback: the data is low-volume and narrative-only, so a broken
selector should degrade to 'stale but correct', never to wrong.
Scope is strictly date, competition, opponent. Do not add venue, round,
kick-off time, lineups or rotation notes -- nothing downstream reads them
and rotation is parked under Manager Styles.
Dates accept '2027-01-10' or '10 January 2027'. Competition accepts any
Premier League entries are ignored by design -- PL occurrence comes from
matches_data.json and listing it here would double-count.
